overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: notice posting at the Town Hall bulletin board was compliant, website posting of minutes and certification forms is not required, and an unraised minutes-creation claim was not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to post meeting agendas and notices to the municipal website instead of only the bulletin board.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Committee complied with the Open Meeting Law’s notice posting requirements and did not violate the law by not also posting meeting notices to the municipal website.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee has continuously failed since 2014 to post its meeting minutes on the municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law where the Committee did not post meeting minutes to the municipal website.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged members' Open Meeting Law certification forms were not posted to the municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law where Committee member’s certification forms were not posted to the municipal website.

allegations.summary: In the request for further review, complainant alleged the committee failed to create and maintain meeting minutes, a claim not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: We find that this allegation was not clearly raised in the original complaint and thus we do not review its merits.
